meta.title: Bacchus's Atlas — list-cover environment archetypes
meta.method: Manual classification of every record from its lore, feature names, impulses, biomes, source and type; no model call at runtime; catalogue not modified.

status_values.moderate: archetype is the best fit but the description is thin or the setting is mixed
status_values.ambiguous: no archetype fits well; primary_archetype is null, candidate_archetypes lists the options
status_values.fallback: no narrative archetype; use the biome image (fallback=biome, plain terrain) or the universal image (fallback=universal, setting-neutral event)

caveats: Classification is a human/LLM judgement made once; confidence is the classifier's own, not measured against a second annotator.
Archetype ids are proposals; art does not exist yet.
Some records have no lore (5 of 316); those were classified from feature names only.
explanation is a short paraphrase of the catalogue text, not a quotation.

taxonomy.name: Haunted & Deathly Places
taxonomy.description: Places where the dead linger: graveyards, haunted houses and cities, gothic castles, the land of the dead.
taxonomy.visual_definition: Night or fog; cold desaturated blues and greys broken by one sickly lantern or will-o-wisp glow; leaning headstones, a gothic silhouette, dead trees.
taxonomy.inclusion: Ghosts, restless dead, cursed or possessed buildings, gothic vampire seats, afterlife landscapes (River Styx, still dead water).
taxonomy.exclusion: Burial architecture with no haunting (crypts-and-tombs); hell and demons (infernal-and-profane).
taxonomy.suggested_artwork_direction: Moonlit overgrown cemetery and a ruined gothic manor beyond it, ground fog, one cold green lantern, ghostly figures barely readable.

existing_art_alternative.why: Mist and gloom exist in the wetland art, but it is a sunlit swamp, not a night-time gothic scene.

taxonomy.name: Forgotten & Ancient Ruins
taxonomy.description: Abandoned castles, temples, cities and monuments of vanished civilizations, reclaimed by nature or time.
taxonomy.visual_definition: Weathered stone architecture in decay; moss, roots and vines; warm shafts of light; sense of scale and age.
taxonomy.inclusion: Ruined castles and towers, lost cities and villages, overgrown temples, standing stones, titan remains.
taxonomy.exclusion: Ruins that are actively haunted (haunted-and-deathly); sunken ruins (drowned-depths); intact arcane towers (arcane-sanctums).
taxonomy.suggested_artwork_direction: Colossal overgrown temple facade half swallowed by ancient trees, light shafts through canopy, tiny explorers for scale.

existing_art_alternative.why: Standing stones and a ruined arch appear, but the focal point is a flower field and it belongs to one environment.

taxonomy.name: Starfaring & Space Opera
taxonomy.description: Warships, orbital blockades, space bars and command centers of the StarHeart / Sovereignty setting.
taxonomy.visual_definition: Metal corridors, viewports onto nebulae or planets, hard rim light, cold blue and amber.
taxonomy.inclusion: Capital ships, Sovereignty bases and outposts, space chases, planetary invasion, command centers.
taxonomy.suggested_artwork_direction: Imperial warship hangar or bridge with a viewport onto a gas giant under fire, small crew silhouettes.

existing_art_alternative.why: A nebula backdrop only; no ships, architecture or focal point.

taxonomy.name: Infernal & Profane
taxonomy.description: Hell's cities and thrones, desecrated shrines, cult rituals and demonic chasms.
taxonomy.visual_definition: Ash, iron and ember light; chains, brimstone, black stone; sickly green or crimson fire.
taxonomy.inclusion: Circles Below locations, demonic pits, cult rituals, corrupted temples, god-slaying rites.
taxonomy.exclusion: Plain volcanic terrain (plain-terrain / badlands art); undead graveyards (haunted-and-deathly).
taxonomy.suggested_artwork_direction: Hell-city of iron bars and chained towers under a burning ash sky, a tiny procession of damned souls on a bridge.

existing_art_alternative.why: Red lava palette matches, but it is open volcanic terrain with no architecture, chains or ritual focal point.

taxonomy.name: Planar Rifts & Shattered Reality
taxonomy.description: Portals, chaos realms, astral and extradimensional spaces, broken reality.
taxonomy.visual_definition: Impossible geometry, cracked ground over starfields, violet and cyan light, floating debris.
taxonomy.inclusion: Portals, planar incursions, astral and chaos realms, shattered lands, metropolises at a nexus of realms.
taxonomy.exclusion: Time loops and dreams (time-and-dream); space-opera ships (starfaring).
taxonomy.suggested_artwork_direction: A tear in a stone plateau opening onto a violet nebula, floating rock shards, a small party at the rim.

existing_art_alternative.why: Cracked terrain falling away into a purple galaxy. Already the right idea; 2048x768 so it needs a wide crop.

taxonomy.name: Storms, Fire & Natural Calamity
taxonomy.description: Weather and disaster as the main event: storms, tornadoes, wildfire, eruption, stampede.
taxonomy.visual_definition: Dramatic sky, hard directional light, motion blur of wind and rain, tiny human figures against a huge force.
taxonomy.inclusion: Thunderstorms, megastorms, magical storms, wildfires, volcanic eruptions, blizzards, stampedes.
taxonomy.exclusion: Time-glitch storms (time-and-dream); settlements merely under siege.
taxonomy.suggested_artwork_direction: A tornado and thunderhead over a farmland valley, crimson lightning, wind-bent grass, a lone road.

existing_art_alternative.why: Fire sky only; no weather event.

taxonomy.name: Cursed & Blighted Lands
taxonomy.description: Natural land corrupted by magic, necromancy or cosmic debris.
taxonomy.visual_definition: Sickly green and violet palette, twisted vegetation, dead earth, unnatural glow.
taxonomy.inclusion: Devouring Green, cursed valleys, anti-life scars, meteoric corruption, slime forests.
taxonomy.exclusion: Swamps (blighted-mires); just spooky woods with a witch (sinister-woods).
taxonomy.suggested_artwork_direction: A once-green valley devoured by glowing violet-green blight, bone-white trees, a cracked road leading to a distant obelisk.

existing_art_alternative.why: A healthy golden forest; wrong palette and mood.

taxonomy.name: Feasts, Festivals & Galas
taxonomy.description: Celebrations, banquets, masked balls and casinos; social occasions as the setting.
taxonomy.visual_definition: Candle and chandelier light, long tables, masks, silk and gold, warm crimson and amber.
taxonomy.inclusion: Feasts, festivals, balls, casinos, dinners and fey revels.
taxonomy.suggested_artwork_direction: A vaulted ballroom of masked guests under chandeliers, one masked figure turned toward the viewer, a long laden table.

existing_art_alternative.why: No interior or social-gathering art exists.

taxonomy.name: Towns, Streets & Markets
taxonomy.description: Lived-in settlements: streets, marketplaces, villages, frontier towns.
taxonomy.visual_definition: Crowded lanes, lantern light, rooftops, stalls, banners; warm and busy.
taxonomy.inclusion: Cities, markets, villages, base-camp towns, street scenes.
taxonomy.exclusion: Interiors like taverns (taverns-and-inns); festivals (feasts-and-revelry); abandoned cities (forgotten-ruins).
taxonomy.suggested_artwork_direction: Dusk market street of a walled town, lantern strings, crowds, rooftops under a violet sky.

existing_art_alternative.why: A harbour town at sunset with lit windows; good for cities, weaker for forest villages and street-level scenes.

taxonomy.name: Arcane Towers & Laboratories
taxonomy.description: Wizard towers, laboratories, observatories and magic shops.
taxonomy.visual_definition: Tall towers, glowing apparatus, floating books and instruments, teal and violet light.
taxonomy.inclusion: Archmage towers, laboratories, workshops, observatories, magic shops, magical metropolises.
taxonomy.suggested_artwork_direction: A spiral wizard tower crowned with a crackling arcane beacon, lit laboratory windows, floating instruments around it.

existing_art_alternative.why: No architecture-led arcane art.

taxonomy.name: Fey Realms & Enchanted Glades
taxonomy.description: Whimsical, dangerous fae courts, wishing glades and story trees.
taxonomy.visual_definition: Luminous purple-blue lights, impossible blossoms, glowing standing stones, dreamlike colour.
taxonomy.inclusion: Fey courts, faerie portals, enchanted groves, fae revels, sentient trees.
taxonomy.suggested_artwork_direction: A moonlit glade of glowing purple blossoms and standing stones, fae lights drifting, a path of mushrooms.

existing_art_alternative.why: Pastel flowers, glowing stones and ghostly lights. Tied to one environment but the style is exactly right; Cauldera Valley adds a purple fantasy valley.

taxonomy.name: Monster Lairs, Hives & Nests
taxonomy.description: Creature homes: dragon hoards, spider webs, insect hives, acid warrens.
taxonomy.visual_definition: Organic tunnels, hoards, egg clusters, bones; claustrophobic scale; sickly or fiery light.
taxonomy.inclusion: Dragon lairs, hives, webbed terrain, burrows, aeries, creature interiors.
taxonomy.suggested_artwork_direction: A dragon hoard cavern inside a volcano, mountain of gold, a vast eye opening in the dark.

existing_art_alternative.why: Glowing-crystal mine; no creature.

taxonomy.name: Sacred Sanctuaries & Divine Places
taxonomy.description: Temples, altars, cathedrals, shrines and divine encounters.
taxonomy.visual_definition: Soaring stone, shafts of golden light, incense, quiet reverence.
taxonomy.inclusion: Healing temples, cathedrals, altars, zen gardens, chapels, divine audiences.
taxonomy.suggested_artwork_direction: Interior of a luminous cathedral nave with a single beam of light on an altar, tiny pilgrims.

existing_art_alternative.why: No sacred architecture art.

taxonomy.name: Strongholds, Sieges & Skirmishes
taxonomy.description: Fortresses, sieges, raids and defensive stands; places to be held or taken.
taxonomy.visual_definition: Walls, banners, siege engines, smoke, torchlight and steel.
taxonomy.inclusion: Fortresses, sieges, raids, bandit hideouts, wall bastions, pitched battles.
taxonomy.suggested_artwork_direction: A river-fort wall at dusk under assault, torches, ladders, a defender on the parapet.

existing_art_alternative.why: Only settlement harbour art shows buildings.

taxonomy.name: Arenas, Duels & Contests
taxonomy.description: Duels, fighting pits, races and contests before an audience.
taxonomy.visual_definition: Sand ring, crowd tiers, spotlight, dust.
taxonomy.inclusion: Duels, fighting pits, racetracks, obstacle courses, tavern brawls (secondary).
taxonomy.suggested_artwork_direction: Sunlit fighting arena with a roaring crowd and two small fighters, dust in the air.

existing_art_alternative.why: No arena art.

taxonomy.name: Blighted Swamps & Mires
taxonomy.description: Swamps and marshes that are corrupted, poisonous or sentient.
taxonomy.visual_definition: Black water, sickly red or green mist, rotting cypress, drowned ruins.
taxonomy.inclusion: Corrupted swamps, blood marsh, mires, sentient ink marsh.
taxonomy.suggested_artwork_direction: A blood-red mire at dusk with half-drowned standing stones and floating wisps.

existing_art_alternative.why: A misty cypress swamp is a good base; lacks the blight and corruption these environments hinge on.

taxonomy.name: Chases, Pursuit & Ambush
taxonomy.description: Scenes defined by motion and surprise: chases, ambushes, escapes.
taxonomy.visual_definition: Motion, dust, rooftops, diagonal compositions.
taxonomy.inclusion: Street and rooftop chases, pursuit, ambushes, train chase.
taxonomy.suggested_artwork_direction: A rooftop chase at dusk: figures sprinting across tiles, a gap ahead, lanterns blurring.

existing_art_alternative.why: No dynamic art.

taxonomy.name: Drowned Depths & Sunken Places
taxonomy.description: Underwater and flooded settings: sunken citadels, trenches, the Umbral Sea.
taxonomy.visual_definition: Shafts of light through deep teal, drifting silt, coral and ruin silhouettes.
taxonomy.inclusion: Sunken ruins, undersea cities, dark seas, trenches, rift baths.
taxonomy.suggested_artwork_direction: A sunken citadel in the deep, sunbeams on columned ruins, a giant shadow gliding above.

existing_art_alternative.why: Aquatic art is a sunlit tropical lagoon; nothing underwater.

taxonomy.name: Intrigue, Courts & Underworld
taxonomy.description: Heists, thieves' guilds, courts, murder mysteries and criminal dens.
taxonomy.visual_definition: Candlelit stone, shadowy alleys, vault doors, chessboard tension.
taxonomy.inclusion: Heists, guilds, gangs, courts, murder mystery, undermarkets.
taxonomy.suggested_artwork_direction: A candlelit vaulted vault-room with a masked cabal around a table and a single ledger.

existing_art_alternative.why: No interior art.

taxonomy.name: Time Anomalies & Dreamscapes
taxonomy.description: Loops, glitching time, prophetic dreams, surreal dream cities.
taxonomy.visual_definition: Clockwork motifs, duplicated figures, soft dream light, impossible architecture.
taxonomy.inclusion: Time loops, chronon pools, time courts, dreamlands, nightmares.
taxonomy.suggested_artwork_direction: A stone courtyard in which one sunset repeats along a ring of sundials, motion-trailed travelers.

existing_art_alternative.why: A looping road with travelers; strong for loops but tied to one environment.

taxonomy.name: Libraries, Archives & Museums
taxonomy.description: Repositories of knowledge, often dangerous.
taxonomy.visual_definition: Towering shelves, floating books, ink, dust motes.
taxonomy.inclusion: Libraries, archives, museums, scholar demiplanes.
taxonomy.suggested_artwork_direction: A vast library hall with floating books and a reading desk under a dome of light.

existing_art_alternative.why: No interior art.

taxonomy.name: Dungeons & Labyrinths
taxonomy.description: Man-made underground complexes of traps, guards and treasure.
taxonomy.visual_definition: Torchlit stone corridors, doors, pits.
taxonomy.inclusion: Dungeons, labyrinths, prisons, trap corridors.
taxonomy.suggested_artwork_direction: A torchlit dungeon corridor with a pit trap and a locked iron door.

existing_art_alternative.why: A mine with rails; no corridors or traps.

taxonomy.name: Perilous Passages & Crossings
taxonomy.description: Rivers, cliffs, passes and thin ice as obstacles to traverse.
taxonomy.visual_definition: Narrow ledge or ford, vertigo, mist, small figures.
taxonomy.inclusion: Rivers, cliffs, mountain passes, frozen lakes.
taxonomy.suggested_artwork_direction: A party on a rope bridge over a misty gorge at dawn.

existing_art_alternative.why: Peaks above clouds with a path; fine for passes and cliffs.

taxonomy.name: Seafaring, Ports & Open Water
taxonomy.description: Ships, voyages, harbours and sea monsters.
taxonomy.visual_definition: Sails, swells, harbour towns, storm light.
taxonomy.inclusion: Ocean voyages, port cities, shipwrecks, lakes with sea monsters, pirates.
taxonomy.suggested_artwork_direction: A galleon cresting a swell as a tentacle rises, storm light on the sails.

existing_art_alternative.why: A tropical lagoon with a sailboat; calm, not a voyage.

taxonomy.name: Sinister Woods & Hag Haunts
taxonomy.description: Menacing forests, witches and hags, twisted trees.
taxonomy.visual_definition: Dark canopy, brambles, twisted trunks, a single warm window.
taxonomy.inclusion: Witch huts, hag woods, spooky forests, glens.
taxonomy.suggested_artwork_direction: A hut on chicken legs deep in twisted woods, a warm window, bramble walls.

existing_art_alternative.why: Forest base but golden and benign.

taxonomy.name: Taverns & Inns
taxonomy.description: Warm social interiors: taverns, inns, speakeasies.
taxonomy.visual_definition: Hearth, timber, mugs, lantern glow.
taxonomy.inclusion: Taverns, inns, speakeasies, brawls.
taxonomy.suggested_artwork_direction: A crowded timber tavern at night, hearth fire, a mysterious stranger in the corner.

existing_art_alternative.why: No interior art.

taxonomy.name: Crypts, Tombs & Catacombs
taxonomy.description: Burial architecture: tombs, catacombs, ossuaries.
taxonomy.visual_definition: Bones, sarcophagi, candle niches, cold stone.
taxonomy.inclusion: Tombs, catacombs, ossuaries, crypts.
taxonomy.suggested_artwork_direction: A catacomb hall of bone-walled niches and a sarcophagus lit by a single candle.

existing_art_alternative.why: A glowing mine, not funerary.

taxonomy.name: Sky Realms & Floating Lands
taxonomy.description: Floating mountains, sky ruins, cloud castles and skyships.
taxonomy.visual_definition: Floating islands, vine bridges, clouds, golden light.
taxonomy.inclusion: Floating mountains, cloud realms, aerial platforms.
taxonomy.suggested_artwork_direction: Floating mountains linked by vine bridges, a skyship passing, golden cloud sea.

existing_art_alternative.why: Peaks above clouds, but ground-bound.

scenarios.title: One environment with unique artwork
scenarios.what_to_evaluate: Single cinematic cover where a real painting exists: 3:2 painting cropped to 16:9 (ENV_ART_FOCUS), no tile logic needed. Baseline for "unique art wins".

scenarios.title: One environment without unique artwork
scenarios.what_to_evaluate: Single cinematic cover from an archetype image (monster-lairs). Checks that an archetype image holds up full-width where a biome picture (badlands, underground, mountain) would be generic.

scenarios.title: Two environments with different visual themes
scenarios.what_to_evaluate: Two-panel split: night gothic vs underwater teal. Evaluates contrast, panel boundary and palette clash.

scenarios.title: Three environments with unique artwork
scenarios.what_to_evaluate: Exactly what ships today. The new system must not regress it; compare the existing 3-tile cover with new layouts.

scenarios.title: Five environments sharing a biome but differing in narrative identity (all forest)
scenarios.what_to_evaluate: Biome art would give five identical covers; archetypes give fey, hag woods, wildfire, blight and bandit stronghold. Tests which three of five are surfaced and in what order.

scenarios.title: Five environments from different biomes
scenarios.what_to_evaluate: Drylands, aquatic, mountain, rolling, underground. Mixes a plain-terrain fallback (biome art) with archetype art (hauntings, tombs, ruins).

scenarios.title: Ten environments with strong thematic diversity
scenarios.what_to_evaluate: Ten different archetypes. Tests the "pick best three" rule, the +7 count treatment and whether a sci-fi image (starfaring) is chosen.

scenarios.title: Ten environments dominated by one archetype (haunted)
scenarios.what_to_evaluate: All haunted-and-deathly. Three tiles of the same image would look repetitive: tests whether one hero image beats a collage, or whether variants (two or three images per archetype) are needed.

scenarios.title: Mixed list with unique artwork and archetype fallbacks
scenarios.what_to_evaluate: One painting, four archetype images (haunted, seafaring, sacred, intrigue) and one plain-terrain biome image. Tests tradeoff between unique art and a list-wide archetype.

scenarios.title: Difficult list where description-based classification adds little
scenarios.what_to_evaluate: Setting-neutral encounters on the universal or settlement biome: chase-and-ambush (moderate), strongholds and arenas, plus ambiguous and abstract-event records. Tests the universal fallback and a deliberate no-false-precision cover.

scenarios.title: Near-duplicate variants of one concept
scenarios.what_to_evaluate: Variant pairs. Tests de-duplication (do not show the same image twice for what is one concept).

scenarios.title: Only settlement-biome environments with different archetypes
scenarios.what_to_evaluate: All primary-biome settlement, so biome art is one identical harbour picture; archetypes give tavern, sacred, intrigue, arcane and stronghold. This is the strongest case for archetypes.

scenarios.title: Style-mismatch stress test (sci-fi only)
scenarios.what_to_evaluate: All starfaring. Tests how a sci-fi image sits beside fantasy art and whether a catalogue-wide style guide still holds.
